item.title: Bridie Goodwin née Deane
item.description: Bridie Goodwin née Deane, Killiney, Castlegregory, (Co. Kerry) Bridie will repose at her residence in Killiney (V92 DN34) on Wednesday from 3 to 8 p.m. Funeral arriving to St. Mary’s Church, Castlegregory on Thursday morning where the Requiem Mass for Bridie will be celebrated at 12 noon. Interment afterwards in Killiney Cemetery, Castlegregory. Donations in lieu of flowers, if desired, to The Palliative Care Unit, U.H.K., or care of The Gleasure Funeral Home, Tralee. item.title: Dillane focusing on La Rochelle despite reports linking him with return to Ireland
item.description: Kerry's Ultan Dillane says his entire focus is on finishing the season strongly with La Rochelle, rather than thinking about reports linking him with a return to Ireland. The former Connacht forward's contract will expire in France at the end of the season, with speculation in recent days that Munster could try and lure him home. item.title: Castleisland beaten in All-Ireland finals
item.description: Castleisland Community College were beaten in both their All-Ireland U16 "A" Schools Cup finals at the National Arena in Dublin today. The girls lost to Presentation Kilkenny 24-48 while the boys went down to St Pats Cavan 36-38. Advertisement

item.title: Tralee gardaí investigate alleged burglary during which woman was threatened with knife
item.description: Tralee gardaí are investigating an allegedly incident during which, it's claimed, a woman was threatened with a knife. It's alleged the incident occurred in a business premises on Rock Street on Saturday, January 10th at around 3.30pm. It's claimed a man entered the building and allegedly threatened a female member of staff with a knife. item.title: Kerry has one of lowest breast cancer survival rates in Ireland
item.description: Kerry has among the lowest survival rates of breast cancer of all 26 counties in the Republic. Data from the National Cancer Registry of Ireland released to Aontú leader Peadar Tóibín shows Kerry had a survival rate of 82.7% for invasive female breast cancer over the last five years. This is the second lowest of any county, behind just Limerick, while it is also below the national average of 87.3%, and 12% lower than the survival rate in Cavan. item.title: Woman claims former Kerry judge sexually assaulted her
item.description: A woman has claimed in the High Court that a now-retired Kerry judge sexually assaulted her at an event in Killarney in 2017. The Irish Independent reports that Jill St John Harrington from Tralee has sued former district court judge in Kerry, James O’Connor from Glenbeigh. She is seeking damages for assault, sexual assault, trespass to the person and personal injury, while all claims are vehemently denied by Mr O’Connor. item.description: Dates have been confirmed for Kerry's games in the Glen Dimplex All-Ireland Intermediate Camogie Championship. The Kingdom open Group 1 at home to Down over the weekend of May 23rd and 24th. They go to Antrim on June 6th or 7th, and host Derry on June 20th or 21st.
